prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution macro shot of a sleek, modern printed circuit board (PCB) with a prominent, metallic, embossed "X" symbol at the center, surrounded by geometric lines and grid patterns etched into the glossy green surface. The composition is tight, focusing on the reflective, silver-toned emblem, which catches soft, diffused lighting, creating subtle highlights and shadows that emphasize its three-dimensional quality. In the blurred background, out-of-focus electronic components—such as connectors and capacitors—add depth and context, while hints of yellow and black wiring provide visual contrast against the deep green of the PCB. The overall style is clean, technical, and futuristic, with a shallow depth of field that draws the viewer’s eye to the central emblem, evoking a sense of precision engineering and advanced technology. The mood is cool and sophisticated, with a cinematic, almost product-advertisement quality, as if showcasing the cutting edge of electronic innovation.
